name: github-mcp-gateway
description: A read-only GitHub MCP server for Cloudflare Workers that reads only the repositories where its GitHub App is installed.

AUTHORIZED_GITHUB_LOGINS.description: Comma-separated GitHub usernames allowed to connect, for example `octocat,hubot`. Matching ignores case. Everyone else is refused after GitHub sign-in.

GITHUB_APP_ID.description: The **App ID** number on your GitHub App's settings page. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/bigbizze/github-mcp-gateway#setup).

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: The **Client ID** on your GitHub App's settings page.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: A client secret. Generate one under **Client secrets** on your GitHub App's settings page.

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: The GitHub App private key. Generate one under **Private keys** on the App's settings page, open the downloaded `.pem` file, and paste all of it, including the `BEGIN` and `END` lines. If the line breaks are lost when you paste, the Worker restores them.

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A random value of at least 32 characters. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

REFERENCE_TOKEN_KEY.description: Exactly 64 hexadecimal characters. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Changing it later invalidates outstanding continuation tokens and artifact links.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth grants and tokens for connected MCP clients.
